comment: Where the brand scan looks. Each entry names the public endpoint, what a result means, and whether a credential is needed. Platforms with no usable API are listed under `manual` and are never emitted as a result, because a check nobody performed is not a finding.

manual.label: LinkedIn
manual.why: no public search API; scraping it breaks their terms
manual.how: Search LinkedIn for the brand and note whether a company page exists and is complete.

manual.label: X
manual.why: search requires a paid API tier
manual.how: Search for the brand name and note whether people outside the company discuss it.

manual.label: G2 and Capterra
manual.how: Check whether a profile exists and how many reviews it carries; these pages are frequently cited in comparison answers.
